title: HostTemplateAssociation
description: PT-0 design-first contract. An ordered, rank-based, first-match binding table mapping hosts to PolicyTemplates (mirrors FortiSIEM 'Host To Template Associations'). effective(host) = rows.sortByRank().first(r => matches(r.match, host)).templates. A row may list several templates -> union+de-dupe merge. The table MUST end with an 'any' catch-all row (see resolver spec). DESIGN-ONLY in PT-0 -- the resolver + Apply/re-push ship in PT-3.

scope.description: Tenant visibility of this association table. GLOBAL = cross-org default binding; ORG = one org's binding.

orgId.description: Required when scope=ORG; forbidden/ignored when scope=GLOBAL. Tenant scoping enforced by RLS in PT-3.

rows.description: Association rows. Evaluated by ascending rank (rank 1 first). MUST contain at least one row and MUST end with an 'any' catch-all (invariant enforced in the resolver, PT-3).

rank.description: Ordering key. Lower rank is evaluated first. Ranks should be unique; ties break by array order (documented in resolver spec).

templates.description: Template names bound by this row. Multiple templates union+de-dupe per the resolver merge rules.

matchSpec.description: Exactly one match predicate. group/host/tag are exact string matches on a host attribute; any:true is the unconditional catch-all.
